title: A sandbox rebuilt with fewer agents leaves no clone or scratch dir of the higher-numbered agents
goal: multi setup (and the reset of a used DIR) removes the clones and scratch dirs of agents above the new count, so a smaller rebuild leaves no 1.3 GB clone behind

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, re, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
def bench(*a):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
import bench_multi
d = os.path.join(T, 's')
p = bench_multi.clone_path(d, 1).parent
try:
    assert bench('multi', 'setup', '--agents', '3', '--coord', 'shared', '--dir', d).returncode == 0
    shutil.rmtree(d)
    r = bench('multi', 'setup', '--agents', '1', '--coord', 'shared', '--dir', d)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr[-300:]
    assert not (p / 'agent3').exists(), 'agent3 clone outlives a rebuild with 1 agent'
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)

notes: Review of SP-7s6uubs7, edge of BG-ytbjm2n6 g2: setup clears only range(1, count+1).
